name: Moovicut
description: Free, deterministic storyboard planner for AI agents: a premise or story prose in, an editable shotboard.v1 out with a short video prompt per shot. No API key, no account, nothing stored. Moovicut does not render video.

skills.name: Plan a storyboard
skills.description: Plan a deterministic board from a premise, story prose, or a scenario. Default 5 scenes of 3 seconds, one short video prompt per shot, lock lines for characters, and a studio link. Accepts shots, duration, scenes, scenario, mode ad, series, or explainer, style presets, prompt_style, and a model profile.

skills.name: Export shot prompts
skills.description: Return the per-shot video prompts for a premise or for an existing shots array.

skills.name: Validate a storyboard
skills.description: Validate a shotboard.v1 document. Returns ok and the shot count, or a named error message. Nothing is stored.
